title: TV5Monde TCF Canada Digital Exam Simulator
description: The largest 100% free digital mock repository with dozens of 40-question series developed directly in partnership with FEI.
whyItWorks: Provides high-volume practice reps under computerized timed conditions with automated diagnostic scoring breakdown by CEFR level.
depthDisclaimer: Deep Practice Bank: Dozens of full practice series available for free.
notesForIndianLearners: Audio plays continuously. Train yourself to read ahead during the pause before each question.
actionGuide: Complete 1 full series every week during B1 and 2 series weekly during B2.

title: RFI Savoirs - Entraînement au TCF (Free Audio Mock Bank)
description: Extensive bank of free graded listening tests with authentic broadcast audio, answer sheets, and complete transcripts.
whyItWorks: Tests your comprehension of radio announcements, interviews, and public debates with authentic background sound.
depthDisclaimer: Deep Practice Bank: Extensive archive of past listening tests.
notesForIndianLearners: Learners often miss subtle negative particles in fast radio audio; use these transcripts to check missed items.
actionGuide: Listen once without pause, answer questions on paper, then check against transcript.

title: France Éducation international (FEI) Official TCF Canada Sample Kit
creatorOrSource: France Éducation international (French Ministry of Education)
description: Official orientation sample papers and MP3 audio directly from the exam owner governing TCF Canada.
whyItWorks: The authoritative benchmark for exact question phrasing, audio speed, and official scoring thresholds.
depthDisclaimer: Orientation Sample: Contains 1-2 official test sets. Use to understand the exact exam format, not as an everyday mock bank.
notesForIndianLearners: TCF Canada listening includes short items (played once) and longer items (played twice).
actionGuide: Take this sample test under strict exam conditions at the start of your B2 Exam Sprint.

title: CCIP Le français des affaires Official TEF Canada Candidate Kit
description: Official candidate guide, sample question sets, and Section A & B speaking/writing prompts from the Paris Chamber of Commerce.
whyItWorks: Sets the direct benchmark for TEF Canada scoring (NCLC 7 = 248+ in CO/CE, 310+ in EO/EE).
depthDisclaimer: Orientation Sample: Official format guide and sample questions from the test owner.
notesForIndianLearners: CRITICAL: TEF Canada listening plays audio ONCE ONLY. Train strictly on single-pass listening.
actionGuide: Use the candidate guide to master examiner evaluation rubrics for Section A and Section B.

title: RFI - Journal en français facile (Daily News + Transcripts)
description: 10-minute daily international news bulletin with simultaneous full written transcripts.
whyItWorks: Essential for **vocal shadowing**: read the transcript aloud while matching native radio speed and intonation.
notesForIndianLearners: Many learners pause between words; shadowing this broadcast trains French enchaînement and continuous breath groups.
actionGuide: Listen blind on Day 1, review unknown vocab on Day 2, and shadow aloud with audio on Day 3.

title: InnerFrench Podcast & Transcripts (Hugo Cotton)
description: Free intermediate podcast with downloadable PDF transcripts covering culture, science, and history at a natural yet comprehensible pace.
whyItWorks: Bridges the gap between beginner textbook audio and native conversational chaos.
notesForIndianLearners: Use transcripts to highlight discourse markers (*en fait, du coup, par contre*).
actionGuide: Listen to 1 episode, then shadow a 2-minute snippet using the transcript.

title: Le Conjugueur (Le Figaro) & Bescherelle Drills
description: Interactive verb conjugation drills covering regular and irregular stems (*présent, passé composé, imparfait, subjonctif*).
whyItWorks: Conjugation hesitation is the #1 cause of stutters in Expression Orale. Automated drills build muscle memory reflexes.
notesForIndianLearners: Verb conjugations in many languages agree with gender; French agrees strictly with grammatical person.
actionGuide: Complete 10 rapid-fire verb drills every morning before touching other media.

title: Lawless French (Comprehensive CEFR Grammar Bank)
description: Indexed CEFR A1-C1 grammar guides with concise English explanations, quizzes, and comparison tables.
whyItWorks: Pinpoints subtle grammar distinctions: *Passé Composé vs Imparfait*, *Subjonctif triggers*, *Pronouns Y and EN*.
notesForIndianLearners: Bookmark the Passé Composé vs Imparfait guide — it maps to completed past vs habitual/ongoing past in most languages.
actionGuide: When encountering an unfamiliar grammar structure in reading/listening, look up its specific rule page here.

title: Anki French Top 5000 Frequency Vocabulary Deck (with Audio)
description: Spaced repetition deck ranked by real-world word frequency, with native audio pronunciation for every card.
whyItWorks: Locks in 3,000 to 5,000 active words in 6-8 months using active recall algorithms.
notesForIndianLearners: Always learn nouns with their articles (*la table*, *le livre*) to encode gender automatically.
actionGuide: Set daily new cards to 15. Complete all due reviews daily.

title: French Sounds & Pronunciation Masterclass
creatorOrSource: French Sounds / Learn French with Alexa
description: Systematic mouth anatomy, IPA vowel drills, nasal vowel production, and rules for silent final consonants.
whyItWorks: Prevents English phonetic interference from fossilizing into bad pronunciation habits.
notesForIndianLearners: French t, d are strictly dental (tongue against upper front teeth), not retroflex. Practice this distinction carefully.
actionGuide: Watch in front of a mirror and practice vocalizing until nasal vowel distinctions feel natural.

title: Wandering French & Ma Prof de Français (Québécois Accent & Vocab)
creatorOrSource: Hélène (Wandering French) & Geneviève (Ma prof de français)
description: Active free YouTube channels explaining Canadian French phonology: affrication of *t/d* into *ts/dz*, nasal vowel shifts, and regional vocabulary.
whyItWorks: Canadian immigration exams feature real Québécois recordings that trip up learners trained exclusively on Parisian French.
notesForIndianLearners: Master key Canadian terms: *le char* (car), *magasiner* (shopping), *la fin de semaine* (weekend), *pantoute* (not at all).
actionGuide: Watch 2 video breakdowns weekly during B1/B2 preparation.

title: Radio-Canada OHdio (Canadian Public Broadcaster Audio)
description: 100% free streaming podcasts and news from Montreal, Quebec City, and Gatineau.
whyItWorks: Immerses your auditory processing directly in real-time Canadian spoken cadence.
notesForIndianLearners: Listen to *Aujourd’hui l’histoire* for clear spoken Canadian French.
actionGuide: Stream as background immersion during commute.

title: French School TV (Vincent) - TEF/TCF Speaking & Writing Templates
description: Structural walkthroughs for TEF/TCF speaking roleplays and formal argumentative writing pieces.
whyItWorks: Gives proven transition formulas and discourse connectors that examiners require for B2 scoring.
notesForIndianLearners: Memorize 5 standard inquiry opening hooks and 4 counter-argument pivots.
actionGuide: Watch a scenario, pause, and record your own 5-minute counter-speech on your phone.

title: Coffee Break French (Season 1 & 2)
description: 15-20 minute guided audio lessons explaining grammar intuitively in English for early learners.
whyItWorks: Builds early listening confidence during downtime.
notesForIndianLearners: Season 1 covers A1; Season 2 covers A2.
actionGuide: Listen to 1 episode daily during commute.

title: Français Interactif (UT Austin Open Curriculum)
creatorOrSource: University of Texas at Austin / COERLL
description: Complete university-grade open educational textbook and audio curriculum covering A0 through B1 with video dialogues and structured grammar exercises.
whyItWorks: Zero paywall, highly organized progression developed by academic linguists for non-native speakers.
notesForIndianLearners: Comprehensive foundation covering verb paradigms, dental pronunciation, and social registers from Day 1.

title: GLOSS Defense Language Institute Audio Repository
description: Authentic listening and reading modules extracted from real French radio broadcasts, press articles, and television debates with synchronized transcripts.
whyItWorks: Trains rapid unscripted listening comprehension at exact ILR / CEFR B1-B2 benchmarks.
notesForIndianLearners: Builds the stamina needed to parse fast international broadcasts without getting overwhelmed by fast accents.

title: Podcast Français Facile (Dialogues & Dictations)
description: Hundreds of graded audio dialogues with full transcripts and crucial dictation (dictée) exercises to master French spelling agreements.
whyItWorks: Dictations bridge the gap between spoken sounds and silent letters in French orthography.
notesForIndianLearners: Essential for mastering silent past participle agreements (-s, -e, -ent).

title: Reverso Context Concordance Engine
description: Search millions of bilingual real-world sentence pairs from official documents, subtitles, and publications to find natural collocations.
whyItWorks: Prevents literal translation mistakes and teaches authentic B2 discourse connectors in context.
notesForIndianLearners: Use this whenever writing formal letters for TEF/TCF to verify exact verb prepositions.

title: Easy French (Authentic Street Interviews)
description: Authentic street interviews across Paris and francophone cities with dual French and English subtitles.
whyItWorks: Exposes your ear to real-world spoken contractions (chuis, dropped ne, fast rhythm) before exam testing.
notesForIndianLearners: Shadow the speakers to pick up natural rhythm and informal Parisian liaisons.

title: Readlang Web Reader & Vocab Importer
description: Click any word on French websites (Le Monde, Radio-Canada) to translate in-context and automatically export flashcards to Anki.
whyItWorks: Enables friction-free reading of native articles months earlier than standard textbook methods.
notesForIndianLearners: Use this to read Canadian immigration articles and Radio-Canada news without stopping every sentence.
